description.value: Wow Grill & Momo is a Surrey restaurant specializing in Himalayan momos and Indian-Chinese fusion cuisine, with an extensive menu of tandoori dishes, curries, and customizable grilled plates. Diners select their own fresh ingredients, which are grilled to order with a choice of sauces, making each meal highly personalized. The restaurant explicitly caters to vegan, keto, and low-carb diets alongside omnivore options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wowgrillmomo.com is active (copyright 2026) and confirms the business is real and operating at 9631 128 Street, Surrey BC V3T 2X8 with phone 604 498 6939. The website explicitly promotes vegan and customizable meal options and confirms online ordering with delivery. No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all are null; the OSM community field incorrectly says Richmond while the website and postal code (V3T) confirm the location is Surrey.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged as 'Richmond' but the website and postal code (V3T 2X8) confirm the business is in Surrey — OSM community tag should be corrected.
OSM cuisine tags (donair;kebab) do not accurately reflect the menu, which is primarily Indian tandoori/curry and Himalayan momos with Indian-Chinese fusion; donair/kebab are not featured.
OSM phone field is empty; phone 604-498-6939 was sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant with a current website, confirmed address, and phone number. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Surrey area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly asks 'Looking for a Vegan Meal? Keto-Inspired Meal? Low carb Meal?' and menu includes Paneer Tikka, Soya Tandoori Chaaps, Malai Soya Chaaps, and other vegetarian/vegan items
